background:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final raster background for a round Pixel Watch face, flat square 1024x1024 artwork.
Input image: style reference only, the second supplied phone screenshot showing a ZENFORM cream watch face. Create a new original background inspired by its wabi-sabi ink-on-paper material quality, not a copy of its clock or interface.
Primary request: finely detailed hand-painted Japanese sumi-e and watercolor on warm aged ivory washi paper, visible paper fibers and tiny natural imperfections. A powerful incomplete charcoal dry-brush enso hugs the LEFT outer margin, approximately x=5%..20%, y=22%..68%, with scraped bristle trails and feathery ink bleeds. A translucent pale ash-gray watercolor wash and a little muted indigo pigment sit in the lower RIGHT margin, around x=78%..94%, y=66%..85%. Add very restrained ochre and faded vermilion pigment touches near the outer margins. Authentic brushwork, nuanced pooling, granular texture, elegant quiet craft.
Composition: designed to be circularly cropped; full-bleed square ivory paper, no watch hardware or bezel. Keep the entire central rectangle x=20%..80%, y=12%..80% VERY PALE and low contrast, mostly open warm paper for a large digital clock, date, health data, and calendar text to be overlaid by software. All dark artwork must stay on the outer left band and sparse outer corners, not behind the central information. Restrained small ink details may approach the bottom edge. The paper texture can cover the whole surface.
Text: none. No letters, numbers, hands, dials, gauges, icons, rings drawn with a vector tool, interface elements, logos, borders or mockup. Actual expressive raster painting with organic brush texture, not SVG, clipart, flat geometric decoration or a clean digital circle. Output only the finished background artwork.
card: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated raster icon for a hand-painted washi-paper watch face, matching the ink and muted pigments of the reference background. A small supermarket loyalty card, viewed straight-on with a very slight handmade tilt. Warm ochre watercolor card body, rough charcoal brush outline, a small indigo pigment square in one upper corner and a loose cluster of short dark vertical barcode strokes along the lower half. Recognizably card-shaped, broad 1.6:1 horizontal rectangle with softly imperfect corners. Visibly painted brush strokes, paperlike pigment granulation, authentic sumi-e craft, readable at 50 pixels. No lettering, numerals, logos, surrounding paper, decoration or extra objects. The single card fills most of the canvas, centered. Background MUST be genuinely transparent, preserve full alpha, not a checkerboard painted into the image. No SVG/vector or flat digital icon style.
heart: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated raster heart icon for a hand-painted washi-paper watch face, matching the rough ink texture of the reference. A recognizable two-lobed heart painted with two expressive vermilion watercolor brush strokes, deep oxide-red pigment pooling and delicate dry-brush imperfections. Warm dark red (#A44537 family), a little variation in density, no highlight gloss, no gradients from a vector tool. Elegant, bold and readable at 24 pixels, with the authentic organic outline of a painted mark. One heart centered and filling 80 percent of a square canvas. Background MUST be genuinely transparent with an alpha channel. No text, numerals, ECG line, border, surrounding paper, shadow or extra object.
stroke: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated charcoal sumi-e brush stroke for a watch-face progress bar, matching the reference's dry ink on paper style. A single long horizontal straight brush mark, around 8 times wider than it is tall. Rich charcoal-black body with fine bristle streaks, rough feathered dry-brush edges, natural hand-drawn start and tapered end. Most of its core should be opaque so it reads at only 8 pixels tall. Center the single stroke; it fills 90 percent of the canvas width. Background MUST be genuinely transparent with an alpha channel, no paper and no checkerboard. No text, symbols, additional marks, circles, decoration, shadows, mockup, SVG or flat vector geometry.
